offering_description.value: Provides regulated water service and some wastewater service to residential, commercial, industrial and public-authority customers. It owns and operates water sourcing, treatment, storage and distribution systems through utility subsidiaries in California, Connecticut, Maine and Texas.

primary_services.value: regulated water utility service; wastewater service; water treatment and distribution; fire protection water service

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households receiving metered water service; B2B: commercial and industrial businesses; B2G: public authorities, municipalities and fire hydrant service for local governments

end_markets.value: residential water supply; commercial and industrial water supply; municipal fire protection; wastewater services

revenue_model.value: service fees: regulated metered water and wastewater rates paid by customers; other: real estate services and other non-regulated activities such as leasing of land and property

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates wells, reservoirs, treatment plants and pipelines, buying some wholesale water and selling to retail customers

geography_served.value: US regional: California (San Jose area), Connecticut, Maine and Texas (Canyon Lake area)

specialization.value: niche specialist: regulated water and wastewater utility service across several state subsidiaries

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct utility service to customers through owned pipeline networks and metering

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rates set by state utility commissions (CPUC, PURA, Maine PUC, Texas PUC), drinking water rules from EPA and state agencies

notes: Formerly SJW Group; renamed H2O America. Details are from memory and may be dated.
